Name: Expanded Slime Ranching and Alchemy
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
My biggest mod thus far, introducing 3 new machines, 3 new special orders, an alchemy system, and more!

[b]Petrification Stations:
[/b]These stations are used to turn 20 slime into petrified slime. Unlocked by completing the "Need Petrified Slime" special order.

[b]Cauldron:
[/b]Brew potions from monster parts and slime! Currently potions can be brewed from all vanilla monster loot (except slime), slime eggs and petrified slime. Unlocked by completing the "Potion Experimentation" special order.

[b]Alchemy Table:
[/b]Further refine your potions into powerful concentrates! These potions last all day long.
Numbers for nerds (Concentrate Price): [i]77 + 2.5B[/i] (B = Base Potion Price, keeps quality).[i] 
[/i]﻿Currently unlocked by completing the "Potion Experimentation" special order, but that will change in a future update!

[b]New Crafting Recipes:[/b][list]
[*]Hardwood: 3 Wood + 1 Petrified Slime. Unlocked at Foraging Level 3.
[*]Prismatic Shard: 1 of each type of Petrified Slime. Unlocked as the final letter from the "Need Petrified Slime" special order.
[/list]
[b]Known Bugs:[/b][list]
[*]Concentrates don't always show their effects, even when EMC is installed.
[*]The "Potion Experimentation" and "Slime Rancher" special orders don't repeat.
[*]The Bug, Void, Solar, and Bone potions are using a placeholder potion asset.
[/list]
[b]Planned Features:
[/b]Most of my ideas for the future of this mod are far outside my current skill set. However, I would ideally like to eventually add the following features:
[list]
[*]Cooking recipes and further enhancements to the alchemy system. These are discussed in more detail here "v2 - Alchemy Expansion
[*]2 or 3 Skill Books with effects ranging from increasing the value of petrified slime to giving slime presses a small chance to produce a tiger slime egg.
[*]2 new pieces of slingshot ammo created from slime and solar/void essence. The solar essence ammo blows up and slows all enemies in its explosion radius while the void essence ammo can shoot through walls, hit rock crabs, and also slow down enemies it hits.
[*]Statues that can be placed in a slime hutch that increase the quality and quantity of petrified slime and slime from surrounding slime balls. The effects of these statues can stack up to 3 times.
Add compatibility with "Mushroom Rancher", and have have these statues provide a chance to double harvest mushrooms (25%, 50%, 100% for each overlapping statue).[*]Slime balls in a slime hutch slowly change color to reflect that of the slimes in your hutch! These slime balls will drop additional items based on their color.
[*]Upgrades to the slime hutch that let you create big slimes.
[/list]And more!
